actor-identity.next: Target the exact remaining source model representative and motion table, then build its complete NPC or monster ecosystem.
actor-identity.reason: Source actor is decoded but no purpose-compatible content identity/placement has been completed. Human, creature, scenery and shadow models must not be interchanged.

effect-reserve.next: Use a verified or inferred compatible event without changing source timing or forcing an unrelated spell.
effect-reserve.reason: Source effect has no completed compatible gameplay-event association. Successful decoding does not establish an original spell identity.

fan-consumer.next: Create a separate fan weapon/recipe/acquisition packet and declare the required attachment capability.
fan-consumer.reason: Three original fan models have no current completed fan-weapon consumer; weapon-family motion support at the receiver is unconfirmed.

head-choice.next: Use a separately declared player-appearance capability and original attachment offsets; do not force heads into helmet slots.
head-choice.reason: Original model contains face/hair, not a verified helmet. Existing four fixed class appearances do not expose a hairstyle choice.

mounted-effect-reserve.next: Retain as an optional effect until a compatible consumer and its capability are defined.
mounted-effect-reserve.reason: Recovered effect99 depicts a mounted apparition; no suitable implemented summon/ride event is established.

no-draw-input.next: Preserve original history and reuse a compatible existing asset for a necessary consumer.
no-draw-input.reason: Source bytes contain zero frames or an empty timeline. There are no original drawable pixels to extract.

shield-consumer.next: Use an independent offhand capability packet with an actual obtainable shield, compatible offsets and intended combat role.
shield-consumer.reason: Source shield is decoded, but current fixed content has no verified compatible offhand consumer or source stat/attachment mapping.

sound-event.next: Resolve original event mapping or listen to a targeted subset before assigning a compatible consumer.
sound-event.reason: Decoded original WAV has no verified source event association; duration alone cannot identify combat, UI or monster role.

ui-event.next: Bind the panel to an existing UI scene through an explicit supported capability, with exact crop/button/text regions and event identifiers.
ui-event.reason: Original UI image is decoded; the current content protocol has no completed UI-skin consumer for this exact panel/button. A role label alone does not bind a runtime event.

v125-motion.next: Resolve source sequence and offsets before deriving compatible actors or overlays; do not assume KR491 tables apply.
v125-motion.reason: Historical v125 sheet is preserved but source motion/attachment mapping is not resolved for a completed consumer.

weapon-reserve.next: Review this exact remaining model and match a distinct existing or obtainable extension weapon role.
weapon-reserve.reason: Source weapon is decoded but has no current completed item consumer; bows and incompatible silhouettes were excluded rather than mislabeled.
